items.name: datatable
items.title: DataTable
items.description: A feature-rich, interactive datatable component built with TanStack Table. Includes sorting, pagination, row selection, loading skeleton, and sequence numbers.

items.name: multiselect
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: A modern, accessible multi-select combobox with search, keyboard navigation, badge chips, option grouping, select-all/clear, and max-selection limits. Self-contained with no extra runtime dependencies.

items.name: markdown-editor
items.title: MarkdownEditor
items.description: A GitHub-style markdown editor with Write/Preview tabs, a formatting toolbar, keyboard shortcuts, and a fullscreen mode, backed by a zero-dependency markdown-to-React renderer (headings, emphasis, lists, task lists, tables, code blocks, links, images).

items.name: html-editor
items.title: HtmlEditor
items.description: A GitHub-style HTML editor with Write/Preview tabs, a tag toolbar, keyboard shortcuts, and a fullscreen mode. Preview renders through a sandboxed iframe so scripts never execute.
